title.text: One site, one look: home → book → pay → booked

how.text:
Press Play on either frame and click through as a customer.

Dates step: pick how many days first (type it, tap − / +, or 3 days / 1 week / 2 weeks / 30 days), then the drop-off day. Only days where the dumpster is free for the whole rental can be picked.

Sample calendar: the dumpster is already booked Dec 9–15. Try 3 days, then 14 days, and watch the open days change.

Desktop: your rental stays pinned on the right. Phone: the bottom bar shows what you've added and the running total.

Real prices from Supabase: 3-day bases $325/$375/$425, prepaid weight $79/ton (vs $99 after), mattress/tire $35, appliance $45. Morning slot counts are sample numbers.

[PRICE] / [TIME] = not set yet. Payment is a placeholder.
